ports.note: Area is acquisition context for OSM; file inputs do not require it.

ontology.note: GeoSPARQL geometry, PROV activity and QUDT buffer units. The mode the graph was filtered for is asserted as fw:travelMode on the network entity -- the term reachability already uses for the mode it assumes -- from src/catchments.ts, so it is declared on the release whose definition is that module rather than here. Configuration SHACL is future work.

changes.description: Reading an extract runs in a worker. A province is twenty to thirty seconds of synchronous WebAssembly, and on the main thread that is twenty to thirty seconds in which the page answers nothing -- Chrome offered to kill it. The extract is transferred to the worker rather than copied and the graph is transferred back, so neither crossing duplicates the bytes, and the status line keeps reporting while it works.

The download budget -- the graph limit and what it accepts -- appears only on the OpenStreetMap download, where it governs something. On an extract nothing is transferred and on an uploaded file the extent is the file's own.

A download whose attempt ran past its 180-second budget said 'signal is aborted without reason', which is the browser's sentence. It now names the budget, says nothing was changed, and points at the extract path, which asks no service.

evidence.note: Acquisition only; the graph it produces is checked where it is used. The pacing follows the service's own /api/status rather than a client-side guess, measured against OSMnx's behaviour on 2026-10-19.
